[[File:Grellik.png|thumb|The Grellik]]
The '''Grellik''' was the name given by the [[Voss commandos]] to a vicious [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] living in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]]. After Grellik killed the commando [[Luta-Vel]], his fellow commando [[Goren-Bo]] asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual to confront and kill the beast. The nexu was put down inside her lair.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Nightmare Predator|[[Voss]]}}</ref>
